race.comment: WINSTON (3) went forward and gave a great sight before finishing third last time out over 2100m at Ballarat Synthetic. Back to turf here is fine, he draws to take plenty of catching. SILVER PLEDGE (2) is close to breaking through, last start finishing just half a length away in second over this trip at Moe. He'll get back but should take holding out in a similar affair. STAUNCH (6) could only manage eighth over 2400m at Sandown-Hillside last start to continue a run of ordinary form. In the mix on best. MATTHEW MARK (5) good effort last time when he finished just 2 lengths away in seventh over 2465m at this track. In the mix.
